authors: Kilian, L.
title: Not All Oil Price Shocks Are Alike: Disentangling Demand and Supply Shocks in the Crude Oil Market
research_focus: 区分供给、全球需求、预防性需求等油价冲击
data_variables: global crude production; real economic activity index; real oil price; inventories/precautionary demand proxy

authors: Caldara, D.; Iacoviello, M.
title: Measuring Geopolitical Risk
research_focus: 构造新闻文本地缘政治风险指数

data_variables: newspaper text; GPR; threat/act subindexes; macro-financial variables
key_finding: GPR 可量化战争威胁与实际行动风险，是油价预测的外生信息候选
reusable_component: 将 GPR 总指数、GPR threats、GPR acts 加入 ARIMAX/VAR/ML 特征组
limitations: 新闻口径对地区覆盖和媒体选择敏感

authors: Baumeister, C.; Kilian, L.
title: Real-Time Forecasts of the Real Price of Oil

key_finding: 基于油市基本面的实时 VAR 在短期预测上可超过 no-change 基准
reusable_component: 作为第一问的基准计量预测模型与滚动窗口评估模板
limitations: 样本与实时数据修订问题复杂；不能直接解释战争因果贡献

authors: Baumeister, C.; Kilian, L.
title: Forecasting the Real Price of Oil in a Changing World: A Forecast Combination Approach
research_focus: 油价预测组合

key_finding: 模型组合可在多时期提升预测稳健性
reusable_component: 把 ARIMA/VAR/GARCH/ML 输出做加权组合，避免单一模型失灵
limitations: 组合权重需要滚动评估；解释性弱于结构模型

authors: Mignon, V.; Saadaoui, J.

authors: Li, X.; Umar, M.; Zhu, C.-B.; Oprean-Stan, C.

research_focus: GPR 多维度预测油价稳定性

limitations: 预测关系可能不稳定；不等于因果效应

title: Forecasting crude oil price volatility out-of-sample using news-based geopolitical risk index: What forms of nonlinearity help improve forecast accuracy the most?

authors: Qian, L.; Zeng, Q.; Li, T.

research_focus: GPR 与油价波动的状态切换关系

authors: Delis, P.; Degiannakis, S.; Filis, G.
title: Navigating crude oil volatility forecasts: Assessing the contribution of geopolitical risk

key_finding: GPR 的预测增量依赖模型设定和评价窗口
reusable_component: 作为 2021-2026 近期预测文献，指导变量增益检验

authors: Plakandaras, V.; Gupta, R.; Wong, W.-K.

authors: Brodersen, K. H.; Gallusser, F.; Koehler, J.; Remy, N.; Scott, S. L.
title: Inferring causal impact using Bayesian structural time-series models
